row.body: The apartment ledger records a tenant moved in before the river-facing rooms were released. The spare key is still logged with the prior renter.
row.title: River-view handover

sidecar.gloss: A move-in predates the release of the rooms and key.
sidecar.rival_reading: A landlord could stage keys during a routine turnover; the ledger does not show who was actually in the rooms.

row.body: the empty sandbag and briefcase are tied with cut warning tape. six tally cuts mark the empty sandbag; only four are crossed through.
row.title: missing count beside the empty sandbag

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
